title: Scribe
subtitle: Dictation to a structured, verified note, on-device

steps.caption: Scribe: dictate or type. Nothing is sent to a cloud transcription service.
Pick the patient, then the free-text consultation goes in.
Structure Note: the local model drafts a SOAP note, then a second pass checks it against the transcript for unsupported claims and omissions before anyone signs it.
Sign & Finalize. This note was typed, never verified against audio, so Orb stops and makes the clinician type SIGN: accepting an unverified AI note is recorded in their own name.
Signed. Signing is the trigger: medications named in the note are extracted, screened, and queued for a pharmacist before they become active orders.
